## Preparation and exploration of data

load data

```{r}
counts_df <- readRDS("../data/counts_df.rds")
tpm_df <- readRDS("../data/tpm_df.rds")
clinical_df <- readRDS("../data/clinical_df.rds")
```

explore the data

```{r}
sum(is.na(counts_df))
colSums(is.na(clinical_df))
identical(colnames(counts_df),clinical_df$sample_id)
table(clinical_df$BOR)
summary(as.numeric(as.matrix(counts_df)))
```
